items.event: UCL MD4: Atlético vs Bayern, Villarreal vs PSG
items.line: Champions League Matchday 4 opens Tuesday with Atlético Madrid v Bayern Munich, Villarreal v PSG, Barcelona v Aston Villa, Man United v Roma and Feyenoord v Inter. Kick-offs are mainly 21:00 CET.
